description: Open source repositories that are in scope for active bug bounty programs, ordered by newest stable release first.

repos.name: cloudflare/workers-py
repos.description: MIT-licensed libraries and tooling for writing Cloudflare Workers in pure Python via Pyodide. In scope for the Cloudflare Public Bug Bounty on HackerOne under the org-wide open source tools asset covering github.com/cloudflare, bounty-eligible up to critical severity. Latest stable release: workers-py-v1.16.2 (2026-08-04).

repos.name: google/adk-python
repos.description: Code-first Python toolkit for building, evaluating, and deploying AI agents. In scope for the Google Open Source Software VRP, listed as tier OT1 with SCOPE_OSS_VRP in Google's published repository tier list. Latest stable release: v2.6.2 (2026-08-04).

repos.name: cloudflare/workerd
repos.description: The JavaScript and Wasm runtime that powers Cloudflare Workers. In scope for the Cloudflare Public Bug Bounty on HackerOne as a named source code asset, bounty-eligible up to critical severity. Latest stable release: v1.20260804.1 (2026-08-04).
